editorial:
If you loved the first Planes movie, this sequel takes things in a totally new direction. Dusty, the famous racing plane, finds out his engine is damaged and he might never race again. Instead of giving up, he heads to a national park and trains to become an aerial firefighter. You meet Blade Ranger, a tough helicopter with a mysterious past, and The Smokejumpers, a fun crew of all-terrain vehicles. The movie has a great message about finding a new purpose when life throws you a curveball. The animation looks bright and colorful, and the firefighting scenes are genuinely exciting for kids and adults alike.

On the plus side, the pacing keeps things moving, the humor lands well, and the emotional moments feel earned. The downside is that some characters feel a bit underused, and the story follows a pretty predictable path. Still, it is a solid family movie night pick. If you have young kids who love planes and trucks, you will have a great time. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, a massive wildfire threatens a crowded lodge full of people. Dusty pushes his damaged engine to the limit to help drop water and rescue trapped guests. His engine finally gives out, but Blade Ranger and the team finish the job. Dusty survives and is honored as a true hero. He decides to stay on as a firefighter instead of returning to racing, finding his new calling.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves animated adventures and family-friendly action.
